name: Émile Durkheim
role: French sociologist and theorist of morality, education and political institutions
summary: Durkheim defended individual dignity through social solidarity, a deliberative state and occupational institutions. He supported secular moral education and criticized conquest, while defending strong marital obligations and opposing divorce by mutual consent.

sources.title: L’individualisme et les intellectuels (1898)
sources.author: Émile Durkheim

sources.title: Le divorce par consentement mutuel (1906)

sources.title: L’Allemagne au-dessus de tout (1915)
